The Windows desktop app (BSS MNT .exe) includes FFmpeg (ffmpeg.exe, from the
ffmpeg-static 5.3.0 package), used only to convert Windows Media files
(ASF / WMV / WMA) to MP4 / M4A on import. FFmpeg is free software licensed
under the GNU General Public License version 3 or later (this build includes
libx264). It runs as a separate program; the licence and build notes are
installed next to it (resources/ffmpeg/LICENSE.txt, README.txt).
Source code: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html · https://github.com/eugeneware/ffmpeg-static
